title: Web UI runtime settings and diagnostics

context.summary: Add read-only Web UI diagnostics for runtime config, providers, jobs and metrics without exposing secrets.
context.background: TASK-126 through TASK-128 added the UI foundation, document workspace and search/context/memory/faces. The next public-ready UI scope is runtime diagnostics before Docker/installer wiring.

in: Add a project-scoped runtime diagnostics HTTP API route with redacted config summary.
Expose storage, vector, antivirus, document processing and LLM/model role settings without raw secrets.
Expose provider health/configured states and metrics links.
Add a Diagnostics UI tab with runtime, providers and recent job status panels.
Use /ready, /v1/runtime/diagnostics and /v1/jobs through the UI API client only.
Add diagnostics workspace validation and include it in pnpm check.
Update README, API docs, UI docs, architecture, support matrix, repository status and changelog.
out: UI Docker image/service and installer routing integration, which is TASK-130.
Playwright E2E acceptance, which is TASK-131.
New backend health probes for external providers beyond current configured/disabled state reporting.

acceptance_criteria: GET /v1/runtime/diagnostics requires projectId and project:read permission.
Runtime diagnostics return redacted install/config summary, storage/vector/AV/model settings, provider health states and metrics links without raw secret values.
The UI Diagnostics tab renders runtime summary, provider settings/health and recent job status through HTTP API calls only.
The UI shows loading, empty, 401/403 and generic error states for diagnostics.
pnpm check includes diagnostics workspace validation, and docs describe the supported diagnostics surface.

manual_checks: Open the UI locally and confirm the Diagnostics tab renders without browser console errors when the API is unavailable.

definition_of_done: Branch is committed and merged back into master.
